core_obligations: Landing: for a bounded coherent object the internal hom into the dualizing complex is again bounded coherent, by the cited finiteness statement (proof lines 2831-2834)
Comparison map: the evaluation isomorphism and the defining properties of the dualizing complex give a canonical isomorphism from the object to its double dual (proof lines 2835-2842)

Conclusion: that isomorphism exhibits the functor as its own quasi-inverse, which gives the anti-equivalence and the statements about the bounded-above, bounded-below and bounded subcategories (proof lines 2843-2844)
proof_roadmap: 由「有限上同调」引理，K ∈ D_Coh(A) ⇒ RHom_A(K, ω_A^•) ∈ D_Coh(A)。
由求值同构（跨章引理）与对偶复形的性质，得典范同构 K = RHom_A(ω_A^•, ω_A^•) ⊗^L K → RHom_A(RHom_A(K, ω_A^•), ω_A^•)。
该同构说明 D 自带拟逆 ⇒ D 是反等价，且交换 D^+/D^-、诱导 D^b 上的反等价。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for a dualizing complex the functor given by the internal hom into it is an anti-equivalence of the bounded coherent derived category, exchanges the bounded-above and bounded-below coherent subcategories and squares to the identity (author lemma at source lines 2817-2829, label lemma-dualizing). The proof (source lines 2831-2845) checks the functor lands in the bounded coherent category and produces a canonical isomorphism from an object to its double dual through the evaluation isomorphism, which makes the functor its own quasi-inverse (proof lines 2831-2844). The comparison map is the substance. H3.
